title: Remote payload stale despite newer version
description: Investigate whether apply_update_result can download a payload whose internal VERSION is older than remote_version and still apply it as success
hypothesis: Remote windows-VERSION can be newer while windows-app-base.zip content/version is stale due release asset cache or mismatch; launcher does not validate payload VERSION before invoking updater

title: Updater in-place replace does not overwrite files
description: Investigate whether replace_in_place_payload or updater_main can return success without actually overwriting VERSION/main.py in writable install directory
hypothesis: In-place updater extraction or copy logic is flawed and silently leaves old files

title: Post-update verification missing
description: Investigate whether launcher reports ok updated true without re-reading installed version after updater exits
hypothesis: apply_update_result trusts updater returncode and clears pending_update without verifying current_payload_version >= remote_version

title: Validate downloaded payload version before updater
description: Add validation that downloaded update zip contains VERSION matching or exceeding remote_version before any backup/apply occurs

title: Fix in-place updater overwrite path
description: Fix updater replacement logic if it cannot overwrite active files or misses VERSION

title: Verify installed version after updater success
description: After updater returncode 0 re-read current_payload_version and fail/keep pending if installed version is still older than remote_version
